book.name: Mateas
book.title: Khoes khabar djaise Mateas liekhies hai

content: Biaah ke nauta ke kaahaanie
Jiesoe swarag ke raadj ke biese me samdjhaawe ke auro matlab ke kaahaanie kahies:
„Ekgo raadja raha. Ek dien oe maangat raha aapan beta ke biaah kare.
Tab djab tem aail tab oe aapan goelaam log ke pathaais nautaharie log ke bolaawe khaatien. Bakie oelog na maangies aawe.
Tab oe doesar goelaam log se sanesa pathaais. Oelog gail bole: ‘Dekh, ham sab khaaik tajaar karlie, khasie-osie gieral, aur sab koetjh tajaar hai. Aawo nauta karo.’
Bakie nautaharie log dhiaan na lagaais. Kauno gail aapan khete, kauno gail aapan kaar-baar dekhe,
aur kauno raadja ke goelaam log ke pakarke natiedja karies aur maar dhaaries.
Tab raadja bahoet goessaail, aur aapan soerdjaatie se ie djaanmarwa log ke marwaai dhaaries, aur oelogke sahar me aagie lagwaai deis.
Tab oe aapan goelaam log se bolies kie: ‘Sab tjiedj tajaar hai, bakie nautaharie nauta laaik na raha.
Toelog dja rasta ke kona kona par aur sab koi ke bola laaw nauta kare khaatien.’
Goelaam log rasta par djaaike dher manai ke ekattha karies, kharaab aur attjha waalan, sab ke. Aur raadja ke mahal nautaharie log se bhar gail.
Djab raadja bhiettar aail aapan nautaharie log se bhet kare, tab oe ek aadmie ke dekhies djaun nauta ke kapra
na pahienies raha.
Tab raadja ose poetjhies: ‘Bhaai, toe biena nauta ke kapra se kaise bhiettar aile hai?’ Bakie aadmie koetjh na bolies.
Tab raadja aapan naukar log se bolies: ‘Ekar haath gor baanhke oke bahare andhiaar me bieg de. Oe hoewa par pastaaike daat pies-pieske khaalie roiga.’ ”
Jiesoe bolies: „Dher manai bolaawal gail, bakie kamtie manai tjoenal gail hai.”
Maahaaraadja ke aur Parmeswar ke hak
Tab Fariesie log djaaike apane me baat-tjiet karies kaise Jiesoe ke tjalaakie se baat se phasaawe ke.

Tab oesab aapan tjela log aur bhie raadja Herodes ke ekaat saathie log ke Jiesoe ke paas pathaais. Oesab djaaike ose bolies: „Maastar djie, hamlog djaaniela kie toe sattja aadmie baate. Aur tjaahe dje djaun bole hai, tabbo toe moeh na dekhe hai aur sattjaai se siekhaawe hai Parmeswar ke rasta par tjale ke.
Ohie se toe hamlogke bataaw kie hamlogke tjaahie Roma ke maahaaraadja ke djoetie ke paisa bhare ke kie na? Toe ka sotje hai?”
Bakie Jiesoe oelogke tjalaakie djaanat raha aur bolies:
„Dhokhaabaadj log, toelog hamke ka adjmaawe hai? Hamke ek paisa dekhaaw djaun se djoetie bharal dja hai.” Oesab ek paisa laais.
Tab oe poetjhies: „Epar kekar moertie aur naam hai?”
Tab oelog bolies: „Maahaaraadja ke.” Tab oe bolies: „Maahaaraadja ke de djaun okar hai, aur Parmeswar ke bhie de djaun okar hai.”
Tab sabhan ie djabaab soenke bahoet atjambho bhail aur oke sanne tjhorke tjal gail.
Maut ke baad ke djiewan
Ohie rodj ekaat Sadoesie Jiesoe ke paas aail. Oesab siekhaawe hai kie koi maut me se na djie oeth sake hai.

Oelog aaike Jiesoe se poetjhies kie: „Maastar djie, Mosas bolies hai kie djab ek aadmie mar djaai aur oke larkan na rahie, tab okar bhaai ke tjaahie okar aurat se biaah karke larkan djalmaawe ke aapan maral bhaai khaatien.
Soen. Saat bhaai raha. Pahielkwa biaah karke mar gail biena larkan djalmaawe. Ohie se okar bhaai oe aurat se biaah karies.
Aisane doesarkwa aur tiesarkwa satwa talak ose biaah karke begar larkan djalmaawe mar gail.
Tab ant me aurat bhie mar gail.
Ab hamlog maangiela djaane kie djie oethe ke dien par aurat kekar rahiega? Oe to saat aadmie ke aurat raha.”
Tab oe bolies: „Toelog Parmeswar ke baat aur okar saktie na djaane hai, ohie se toelog khaalie oelta-phoelta sotje hai.
Djie oethe ke baad koi na biaah kariega. Manai logan djaise swarag ke parie logan rahiega. Oesab biaah bhie na kare hai.
Aur djie oethe ke baare me, toelog na parhle hai kie Parmeswar toelogke baap-daada log ke biese me ka bolies hai? Oe bolies kie:

content.text: ‘Ham Aabraaham, Iesaak aur Jaakob ke Parmeswar baatie.’

content: Oe maral logan ke Parmeswar thoro hai, bakie djienda manai logan ke.”
Tab manai log ie sab gjaan soenke bahoet atjambho bhail.
Parmeswar ke sab se barka hoekoem
Djab Fariesie log soenies kie Jiesoe Sadoesie log ke moeh band kar deis hai, tab oesab ekattha hoike okar lage aail.
Oesab me se ekgo dharam ke kaanoen ke parhal waala maangies oke baat se phasaawe.
Oe poetjhies: „Maastar djie, Parmeswar ke kaanoen me sab se barka hoekoem kaun hai?”
Tab Jiesoe bolies: „Prabhoe tor Parmeswar hai aur toke tjaahie oke diel bhar se, tan-man se aur aapan sab boeddhie se prem kare ke.
Ie sab se barka aur pahiela hoekoem hai.
Doesara hoekoem ohie ke baraabar hai. Toke tjaahie ek doesare ke apane ghat tjaahe ke.
Parmeswar ke saara kaanoen aur okar sanesian ke sab liekhal baat ie doei hoekoem ke biese me hai.”
Kriest Daawied ke aulaad aur okar Prabhoe hai
Djab Fariesie log ekattha raha tab Jiesoe oelogse poetjhies:
„Toelog ka sotje hai Kriest ke baare me? Oe kekar aulaad hai?” Tab oelog bolies: „Raadja Daawied ke.”
Tab oe bolies: „Attjha. Bakie Daawied Pawietr Aatma ke dwaara kaise oke aapan Prabhoe bolaai sakat raha? Oe to bolies hai:

content.text: ‘Parmeswar hamaar Prabhoe se bolies hai kie:
Aaw hamaar dahiena bagal baith djab lek ham tor doesman ke tor gor ke nietje na kar debe.’

content: Daawied oke Prabhoe bolaawe hai, tab oe kaise okar aulaad bhie hoi sake hai?”
Ie baat par koi na djabaab dei paais aur ohie dien se koi ke hiemmat na paral phien se oke adjmaawe ke.

footnotes.text: Sion ek doesar naam hai Jeroesaalem sahar khaatien.
